entries.head: logql
entries.rationale: every vector-aggregation op the LogQL grammar accepts is handled: sum/avg/min/max/count/stddev/stdvar build an AggFunc here, and topk/bottomk/sort/sort_desc/approx_topk route to lowerTopK/lowerSort before this switch. The only remaining op constant (__count_min_sketch__) is a shard-mapper internal the parser never yields from a wire query, so the default arm is unreachable.

guard: past exhaustive switch e.Operation over [case syntax.OpTypeSum; case syntax.OpTypeAvg; case syntax.OpTypeMin; case syntax.OpTypeMax; case syntax.OpTypeCount; case syntax.OpTypeStddev; case syntax.OpTypeStdvar]

guard: past exhaustive switch e.Operation over [case syntax.OpTypeTopK, syntax.OpTypeBottomK, syntax.OpTypeApproxTopK; case syntax.OpTypeSort, syntax.OpTypeSortDesc]
